description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Ghired by tapping a nontoken creature you control, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.
